{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

df_clean = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]
df_dedup = df_clean.sort_values(by="sample_seq", ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup["arm"] == "treatment"]

# Check severity by sex
severity_sex = pd.crosstab(df_treatment["sex"], df_treatment["severity"])
print("Severity by sex in treatment arm:")
print(severity_sex)

# Compute response rates by sex (unadjusted)
response_rate_by_sex = df_treatment.groupby("sex")["responded"].mean() * 100
female_rate = response_rate_by_sex["F"]
male_rate = response_rate_by_sex["M"]
diff = female_rate - male_rate

# Now, adjust for severity using stratified analysis
# Compute response rate within each severity stratum
stratified_rates = df_treatment.groupby(["sex", "severity"])["responded"].mean() * 100

# Print stratified response rates
print("\nResponse rates by sex and severity:")
print(stratified_rates.unstack())

# Compute weighted average response rate by sex, weighted by severity distribution
# Use overall severity distribution as weights
severity_dist = df_treatment["severity"].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Weighted average response rate per sex
weighted_female = (stratified_rates["F"] * severity_dist).sum()
weighted_male = (stratified_rates["M"] * severity_dist).sum()

# Adjusted difference
adjusted_diff = weighted_female - weighted_male

# Output
print(f"\nUnadjusted female response rate: {female_rate:.2f}%")
print(f"Unadjusted male response rate: {male_rate:.2f}%")
print(f"Unadjusted difference: {diff:.2f} percentage points")

print(f"\nWeighted average female rate (adjusted): {weighted_female:.2f}%")
print(f"Weighted average male rate (adjusted): {weighted_male:.2f}%")
print(f"Adjusted difference (female - male): {adjusted_diff:.2f} percentage points")

# Return values
print(f"{female_rate}")
print(f"{male_rate}")
print(f"{diff}")
print(f"{weighted_female}")
print(f"{weighted_male}")
print(f"{adjusted_diff}")"}
